name: Aozora Kagome
source:
Occupation: Student

Subject: Mathematics

Personality: A genius girl who spits out poisonous words. She is the youngest daughter of the Aozora sisters, who thinks and feels a little out of place in the world. She is a genius when it comes to sports and studies, but she is clueless when it comes to sex.
